results.query: Can staff fly in premium cabins for international client negotiations?
results.answer_1_baseline: No. Based strictly on the provided policy passages (Section 2.1 'Standard Cabin Class Mandate'), all domestic and international air travel must be booked exclusively in Standard Economy (Coach) class, regardless of employee seniority, managerial title, or total travel duration.
